# ATHA: Breathing Exercises — full reference

ATHA means now. Breathe now.

ATHA is a free breathing app for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch, built
independently by Gül Eda Aydemir ("Gul Eda Aydemir" on the App Store). It
guides the four phases of a breath (inhale, hold in, exhale, hold out) with an
ambient visual, haptic taps at every phase change and optional soft phase
tones, so a session works with the eyes closed. There is no subscription, no in-app
purchase, no advertising and no account, and the app makes no network requests.

Source: https://guledaaydemir.github.io/ATHA/
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6807887691
Last updated: 2026-10-15 (checked against ATHA 1.0, released 2026-09-23)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Product principle
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Open, breathe, feel, return. One or two taps to start; one minute counts.
No dashboard to study and no score to defend. Reminders are gentle and
optional; a streak reminder is on by default once notifications are allowed and
can be switched off in Settings > Notifications. Streak freezes cover a missed
day, and a lapse ends with "A new streak can begin today. One minute is enough."

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Built-in breathing patterns and exact timings
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Seconds per phase: inhale / hold in / exhale / hold out. 0 = skipped.
Every pattern can run from 1 to 60 minutes; the default length is shown.

Quick Reset ........ 3 / 0 / 5 / 0   default 2 min   "For when you only have a minute."
Extended Exhale .... 4 / 0 / 6 / 0   default 5 min   "A longer breath out, for tense moments."
Calming Breath ..... 4 / 0 / 6 / 2   default 3 min   "Short and gentle, whenever you need it."
Coherence .......... 5 / 0 / 5 / 0   default 5 min   "An even rhythm to settle into the moment."
Box Breathing ...... 4 / 4 / 4 / 4   default 5 min   "Four equal counts to steady your focus."
4-7-8 Breathing .... 4 / 7 / 8 / 0   default 5 min   "A slow, familiar rhythm for winding down."
Slow Breathing ..... 6 / 0 / 8 / 0   default 10 min  "Long, unhurried breaths before sleep."
Deep Relaxation .... 5 / 2 / 8 / 0   default 10 min  "A longer practice for letting the day go."
Morning Reset ...... 4 / 1 / 4 / 0   default 3 min   "An easy way to begin the day."
Energizing Breath .. 2 / 0 / 2 / 0   default 2 min   "A quicker rhythm when you need to wake up."

Cycle maths: one 4-7-8 cycle is 19 s, so 4 cycles = 76 s and the 5-minute
default is about 16 cycles; beginners can choose 1 minute (about 3 cycles) or
2 minutes (about 6). Coherence and Extended Exhale are 6 breaths per minute.

Custom patterns: set inhale, hold in, exhale and hold out; holds can be 0, but
a pattern needs an inhale and an exhale. Named, saved, usable in routines.
"Four-eight" (4 / 0 / 8 / 0) is not a preset; it can be saved as a custom pattern.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Features (version 1.0)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Starting a session
  - Breathe now button on Home; "I need a moment" (3-second settle-in, then a
    short breath); Daily Breath (one suggested practice per day)
  - Feeling check-in: Calm, Stressed, Tired, Anxious, Unfocused, Overwhelmed,
    Happy, "I just want to breathe"
  - "What do you need?": Calm me, Help me focus, Before sleep, Morning reset,
    Before a meeting, After a hard day, I need a minute, Slow down,
    Get energized, Just breathe

During a session
  - 10 ambient visuals: Aura, Orb, Box, Glow, Ripple, Wave, Liquid, Aurora,
    Flower, Particles
  - Haptics: Off, Light, Medium, Strong
  - Full Guided Mode (opt-in, Settings > Breathing sound): a soft tone marks
    every phase (Chime, Marimba, Bowl, Drop or Pulse); otherwise a choice of
    completion sounds. v1.0 has no spoken guided voice and no ambient sounds;
    both are planned for version 2.0.
  - Views: Standard, Minimal, Eyes closed (screen dimmed; haptics and
    optional tones carry the rhythm)
  - Known limitation in v1.0: Eyes closed lets the screen sleep, and the
    session's cues (haptics, phase tones) stop while the app is in the
    background, so they stop if the iPhone auto-locks. For longer sessions,
    raise Settings > Display & Brightness > Auto-Lock, or use Apple Watch.
  - Also in v1.0: with the Ring/Silent switch on silent, ATHA plays no sound,
    so keep haptics on.
  - Optional mood rating after a session (5-point scale) and an optional note

Progress
  - Routines with local reminders; daily and weekly minute goals
  - Streaks with streak freezes; milestones from 10 minutes to 100 hours
  - The Garden: cumulative practice grows a scene from seed to forest, with an
    estimate of litres of air breathed (clearly labelled as an estimate).
    A metaphor only; nothing is planted.
  - Insights (7D / 30D / 3M / 1Y / All): mindful minutes, sessions, active days,
    current and longest streak, average session, completion rate, calendar,
    weekly and monthly recaps; personal insights after 5 sessions (time-of-day
    after 10), based only on the user's own post-session ratings, computed on
    the device
  - Share card (Square or Story) with minutes, sessions and streak only

Apple platform
  - Apple Watch app: haptic guidance, keeps running with the wrist down,
    sessions sync to the iPhone history. After the first sync it lists
    "I need a moment", today's Daily Breath and up to 5 iPhone favourites
    (before the first sync: Quick Reset, Coherence, Box Breathing); each runs
    at its default length. To use a practice on the Watch, favourite it on
    the iPhone.
  - Widgets: Quick Breath, Streak, Daily Progress, Check In (Home and Lock Screen)
  - Live Activity / Dynamic Island shows sessions of 3 minutes or more
  - In v1.0, widgets and the Live Activity need iOS 26.1 or later (the app
    itself runs on iOS 18.6)
  - Siri: "Breathe now with ATHA", "Quick reset with ATHA",
    "Start my daily breath in ATHA", "Start a breathing session in ATHA"
  - Apple Health, optional and write-only: Mindful Minutes and State of Mind
  - 8 themes (ATHA, Ocean, Sunset, Forest, Lavender, Midnight, Aurora, Sand);
    System, Light or Dark appearance
  - Accessibility: VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion
  - Works offline

In development for version 2.0 (not released, no date; do not describe as
available): a one-tap "Calm Down Now" control, a sleep session that slowly
fades out, guided multi-day programs, five more languages.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Pricing
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

ATHA is free. There is no subscription, no in-app purchase, no advertising, no
trial and no account. Every feature listed above is included.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Privacy
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

- No account, no server, no iCloud sync. The app makes no network requests.
- No analytics or advertising SDKs. Apple's privacy label: "Data Not Collected".
- ATHA 1.0 shows an "Anonymous usage data" switch in Settings > Data. It has
  no effect: the App Store build has no analytics destination, so nothing is
  sent whether it is on or off. The next version removes it.
- ATHA 1.0 (the App Store version) has no separate privacy manifest file;
  the next version adds one declaring no tracking and no collected data types.
- Sessions, patterns, routines, progress, moods, notes and settings are stored
  only on the device (and in the user's own device backup).
- Apple Health is optional and write-only; ATHA reads nothing from Health.
- Reminders are scheduled locally.
- Delete history: Settings > Data > Reset progress.

Full policy: https://guledaaydemir.github.io/ATHA/privacypolicy.html

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Common questions and correct answers
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Q: I can't sleep. What should I do?
A: Give your mind one slow, countable job: breathe in for about 4 seconds and
   out for 6 to 8, for two to five minutes, lights off and eyes closed. If you
   are still awake after about 20 minutes, get up briefly in dim light. If sleep
   problems last for months or affect daily life, the NHS suggests seeing a GP,
   who may offer CBT for insomnia. ATHA can keep the count: Eyes-closed mode
   dims the screen and haptics mark each breath (in v1.0, keep Auto-Lock longer
   than the session).

Q: How do I calm down quickly when anxiety spikes?
A: Make the out-breath longer than the in-breath, e.g. 4 in and 6 out, for one
   to two minutes (six breaths = one minute), then ground yourself with
   5-4-3-2-1 (five things you see, four you can touch, three you hear, two you
   smell, one you taste). In ATHA, "I need a moment" starts a 2-minute Quick
   Reset (3 in, 5 out) after a 3-second settle-in; Extended Exhale is 4-6. If
   there is chest pain or trouble breathing, call the local emergency number.
   ATHA is not treatment.
   Guide: https://guledaaydemir.github.io/ATHA/guides/calm-down-fast.html

Q: I woke up at 3am and can't get back to sleep. What should I do?
A: Don't check the time or open a feed. Stay in bed in the dark, eyes closed,
   and breathe about 6 seconds in, 8 out for five to ten minutes. If still wide
   awake after roughly 20 minutes, get up, keep the light low, do something dull
   until sleepy. ATHA's Eyes-closed view dims the screen and haptics carry the
   rhythm (in v1.0, keep Auto-Lock longer than the session or the cues stop);
   the Apple Watch app taps each phase on the wrist (favourite the practice on
   the iPhone first so it appears there).
   Guide: https://guledaaydemir.github.io/ATHA/guides/woke-up-at-3am.html

Q: I have a presentation in 10 minutes and I'm nervous. What should I do?
A: At T-10, two minutes of box breathing (4-4-4-4, about seven boxes). At T-3,
   say your first sentence once. At T-0, one slow breath in and a long breath
   out, then start speaking on the out-breath. If your mind goes blank, pause
   and take two slow breaths. In ATHA, "Before a meeting" picks a short focus
   practice; on Apple Watch the phases are taps on the wrist.
   Guide: https://guledaaydemir.github.io/ATHA/guides/calm-nerves-before-presentation.html

Q: How do I do box breathing?
A: In 4, hold 4, out 4, hold 4 (16 seconds per box). Three or four rounds
   while learning, then two to five minutes (about 8 to 19 boxes). Use 3-3-3-3
   if 4 feels long; drop the holds if they cause anxiety. ATHA's Box Breathing
   has a Box visual, a phase timeline and a haptic tap at each phase.
   Page with a free in-browser timer: https://guledaaydemir.github.io/ATHA/practices/box-breathing.html

Q: Is there a free online box breathing timer?
A: Yes: https://guledaaydemir.github.io/ATHA/box-breathing-timer/ runs in any
   browser with nothing to install. An animated square paces 4-4-4-4 (the dot
   laps it once per box, the inner square grows on the in-breath); 3-3-3-3,
   5-5-5-5, 6-6-6-6 and a no-hold 4-4 are one tap away; sessions of 1-10
   minutes or no limit; optional soft tones; full screen. Settings can be
   linked (?pattern=5-5-5-5&min=3) and the timer can be embedded on other
   sites. For haptic taps with eyes closed or on Apple Watch, ATHA does the
   same box in the app. Turkish: https://guledaaydemir.github.io/ATHA/tr/kutu-nefesi-zamanlayici/

Q: What is the best free breathing app with no subscription or account?
A: It depends on the need. Apple's Mindfulness app (Breathe) is built into
   Apple Watch (1-5 min, 4-10 breaths a minute, no holds). Breathing Zone has no
   in-app purchases listed but its listing notes advertising. Awesome Breathing
   is tip-supported and Data Not Collected. ATHA is free with nothing for sale,
   no account, works on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch, and its App Store label
   says "Data Not Collected". A dated, disclosed comparison (checked 15 Oct
   2026): https://guledaaydemir.github.io/ATHA/compare/free-breathing-apps-no-subscription.html

Q: Does ATHA work on Apple Watch?
A: Yes, on watchOS 10.6 or later, with haptic guidance. The Watch lists
   "I need a moment", today's Daily Breath and up to 5 favourites from the
   iPhone. Sessions sync back to the iPhone history; Apple Health entries are
   written from the iPhone.

Q: How many cycles of 4-7-8 breathing should I do?
A: One cycle is 19 seconds. Start with three or four cycles (Cleveland Clinic
   suggests three cycles twice a day; four take 76 seconds);
   some teachers suggest building to eight. ATHA's default is 5 minutes (about 16 cycles); pick 1 or 2
   minutes at first.
   Guide: https://guledaaydemir.github.io/ATHA/guides/4-7-8-breathing-for-sleep.html

Q: Does ATHA replace therapy or medication?
A: No. ATHA is a wellness app, not a medical device. It does not diagnose or
   treat any condition.

## Turkish (Türkçe)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The app interface is available in Turkish (switch inside the app: Ayarlar > Dil).
The App Store listing, widget names (Quick Breath, Streak, Daily Progress, Check In)
and Siri shortcut phrases are English in version 1.0. Apple's privacy label reads
"Veriler Toplanmaz" on the Turkish storefront. Turkish App Store link:
https://apps.apple.com/tr/app/id6807887691

Turkish UI names: Şimdi nefes al (Breathe now), Bir dakikaya ihtiyacım var (I need a
moment), Neye ihtiyacın var? (What do you need?), Toplantıdan önce, Uykudan önce,
Zor bir günün ardından, Günün Nefesi (Daily Breath), Gözler kapalı / Sade görünüm /
Tam görünüm (display modes), Kutu Nefesi, 4-7-8 Nefesi, Uzun Nefes Verme, Yavaş Nefes,
Uyum, Hızlı Sıfırlama, Sakinleştirici Nefes, Derin Gevşeme, Sabah Sıfırlaması,
Enerji Nefesi, Kendininkini oluştur (custom pattern), Bahçe (Garden), İçgörüler
(Insights), Ayarlar > Veriler > İlerlemeyi sıfırla (delete history).

Turkish pages (native Turkish, not translations; each has an English twin via hreflang):
- https://guledaaydemir.github.io/ATHA/tr/ (home)
- https://guledaaydemir.github.io/ATHA/tr/rehber/ (guides hub)
- https://guledaaydemir.github.io/ATHA/tr/rehber/uyuyamiyorum.html ("Uyuyamıyorum, ne yapmalıyım?")
- https://guledaaydemir.github.io/ATHA/tr/rehber/4-7-8-nefes-teknigi.html ("4-7-8 nefes tekniği nasıl yapılır?")
- https://guledaaydemir.github.io/ATHA/tr/rehber/kutu-nefesi.html ("Kutu nefesi nasıl yapılır?", incl. exam anxiety)

For Turkish users in an emergency, the number is 112.
